_about: Config for .github/scripts/{build,check,smoke}_release_tree.py (#437, ported from claude-remember's #851). The `release` branch is what the Anthropic plugin directory fetches; main keeps everything. See docs/releasing.md (ported from claude-remember's docs/releasing.md 'Reusing this in another plugin repository' section).
_deny_why: Deny-list, not allow-list: a path forgotten here ships and is caught loudly by the size/count check; a path forgotten in an allow-list would vanish from users' installs silently. Entry ending in '/' = directory prefix, otherwise an exact path. Every entry here was checked against what hooks/hooks.json, scripts/*.sh and .claude-plugin/plugin.json actually load at runtime before being added (#437) -- see each entry's own comment in the PR/issue for the reasoning; summarised: tests/docs/.github/.oss/.agents/outbound are dev-or-maintainer-loop tooling the plugin's own runtime never opens, changelog.d/trap.d are fragments folded or curated elsewhere, .claude/ is this repo's OWN dogfood use of the plugin rather than the plugin's shipped content, and the dotfile configs are this repository's contributor tooling.
_budget_why: max_file_bytes and max_files are the directory's own rules (pre-submission checklist, 'Files in the plugin folder'); images and fonts are exempt from the per-file limit. max_total_bytes (3 MiB) is this repository's own ceiling, matching claude-remember's -- the shipped tree here measures about 2.1 MB (#437), comfortably under it.
